capabilities.name: CapFoundry.csv.detectDelimiter
capabilities.description: Infer which character separates fields in CSV-like text, with supporting evidence
exampleQueries: work out whether this file is comma or semicolon separated
detect the field separator in an unknown spreadsheet export
is this data tab delimited or pipe delimited
sniff the delimiter before parsing a flat file
guess how these columns are separated
capabilities.inputSummary: CSV-like text plus optional candidate characters and a row limit
capabilities.outputSummary: The likely delimiter, a confidence, the field count and per-candidate evidence

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.date.businessDaysBetween
capabilities.description: Count working days between two dates, excluding weekends and supplied holidays
exampleQueries: how many working days are there between these two dates
count weekdays excluding public holidays for an sla
number of office days in a delivery window
business days from order date to due date
weekdays between two dates with a friday saturday weekend
capabilities.inputSummary: Two ISO dates plus optional weekend days, holidays and inclusivity
capabilities.outputSummary: Business days with a breakdown of calendar, weekend and holiday days

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.geo.distance
capabilities.description: Calculate the great-circle distance between two geographic coordinates
aliases: how far apart are two points
exampleQueries: calculate distance between two latitude longitude coordinates
how many kilometres between these two GPS points
great circle distance between two places on earth
how far apart are two coordinates in miles
compute haversine distance between two positions
capabilities.inputSummary: Two WGS-84 points as lat/lon degrees, plus an optional unit
capabilities.outputSummary: Great-circle distance as a number in the requested unit

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.geo.geocode
capabilities.description: Resolve an address or place name to coordinates, refusing when the name is ambiguous
aliases: look up latitude and longitude for a place
find where a street address is
turn a city name into a position
exampleQueries: what are the coordinates of this street address
convert a city name into latitude and longitude
find the position of a postal address in Denmark
resolve a place name to a point on the map
geocode an address so I can measure from it
which country is this town in
capabilities.inputSummary: A free-text address or place name, with an optional country code, language and result limit
capabilities.outputSummary: A resolved place with coordinates, or an ambiguous or not-found verdict with the candidates

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.json.schema.infer
capabilities.description: Infer a deterministic JSON Schema from an example JSON value using explicit rules
aliases: generate a schema from sample data
derive a contract from an api response
build validation rules from an example payload
work out the structure of this json
exampleQueries: generate a json schema from this example api response
derive validation rules from a sample payload
what is the structure of this json data
turn these example records into a schema contract
infer types and required fields from sample json
capabilities.inputSummary: Any JSON value plus optional enum, format and depth options
capabilities.outputSummary: A draft 2020-12 JSON Schema, byte-stable for the same input

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.sun.times
capabilities.description: Calculate sunrise, sunset, twilight and golden hour for a date and location
aliases: what time does the sun rise
exampleQueries: what time does the sun rise and set at these coordinates
calculate golden hour for a photo shoot on a given date
how long is the day at this latitude in December
when does civil twilight end tonight
find solar noon for a location
does the sun set at all here in midsummer
capabilities.inputSummary: A latitude, longitude and ISO date, plus optional observer height and IANA time zone
capabilities.outputSummary: Each solar phase as an ISO 8601 instant or null, with solar noon and polar day/night flags

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.text.editDistance
capabilities.description: Levenshtein edit distance and similarity between two strings
exampleQueries: how many single character edits turn one word into another
measure how different two strings are
fuzzy match two pieces of text by character edits
score how closely a user typed name matches a record
find the nearest spelling of a misspelled word
capabilities.outputSummary: Edit distance, a normalised similarity score and both code point lengths

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.text.slugify
capabilities.description: Convert arbitrary text into a stable URL-safe and filename-safe slug
aliases: clean up a title for a url
exampleQueries: turn a blog post title into a url friendly string
make a permalink from a heading with accents
convert a product name into a safe filename
generate a kebab case identifier from free text
strip diacritics and spaces to build a web address
capabilities.inputSummary: Free text plus optional locale, separator, maxLength and lowercase
capabilities.outputSummary: A stable slug and whether it was truncated

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.ui.dataTable
capabilities.description: Generate a framework-free, accessible sortable table as an HTML Custom Element, with an openable preview
aliases: build a table without a framework
exampleQueries: generate a sortable table web component for these columns
i need an accessible html table widget without react
create a custom element that renders rows with column sorting
vanilla javascript data table with keyboard accessible sorting
build a framework free table component from a column spec
give me a table i can open in a browser with these rows already in it
capabilities.inputSummary: A column spec, optional sample rows, plus caption, empty text and element name
capabilities.outputSummary: Custom Element source, a usage snippet with your rows, and a standalone HTML preview

capabilities.name: CapFoundry.validation.iban
capabilities.description: Validate an IBAN against ISO 13616 length, charset and mod-97 checksum rules
exampleQueries: check whether this bank account number is valid
validate an international bank account number before saving it
is this sepa payment detail correctly formatted
verify the checksum on a customer bank account
normalize and check a bank account string from a form
capabilities.inputSummary: An IBAN string, with or without spaces
capabilities.outputSummary: Validity, normalized and printed forms, country code and a machine-readable reason
